note: Generic character-sheet template. tools/make_kit.py fills the {placeholders} from a character spec and writes kits/<id>_sheet_kit.json. A cell with 'repeat' is expanded once per item of that spec list (gear_items, swatches); item fields are available as placeholders and may override size/ref_prefix.

kit_defaults.ref_prefix: Edit instruction: keep this exact same character from the reference image, identical face, hair, {facial_hair}, costume, colours and materials. Change only the following:
kit_defaults.style: Photorealistic, ultra-detailed fabric, skin and metal, soft even studio lighting, plain dark neutral grey background, sharp, AAA game character reference sheet cell, 1.5 megapixel. Not cartoon, not stylised, no text.

cells.prompt: Orthographic character turnaround, FRONT view, strict A-pose with arms about 30 degrees away from the body, legs slightly apart, full body from head to shoes fully visible, centred, neutral expression.
